terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of Crafty Bass. By creating an account or using the service you agree to them.

sections.heading: 1. About Crafty Bass
sections.body: Crafty Bass is a marketplace that connects homeowners with verified tradespeople in Sri Lanka. We help you find, compare and hire — but the work itself is agreed directly between the homeowner and the tradesman. We are not a party to that agreement.

sections.heading: 2. Accounts and verification
sections.body: You must give accurate details when you sign up and keep them up to date. Tradespeople are verified manually against their NIC, trade credentials, address and bank details. Only verified tradespeople can receive jobs or send quotes.

sections.heading: 3. Jobs, quotes and hiring
sections.body: Homeowners describe a job; tradespeople submit quotes. Accepting a quote forms an agreement between you and that tradesman to carry out the work for the quoted price, subject to any changes you both agree.

sections.heading: 4. Payments and escrow
sections.body: Where a materials deposit is requested, you pay Crafty Bass — not the tradesman — and we hold the funds in escrow. Deposits are refundable until work begins. The balance is released to the tradesman when you approve the completed work.

sections.heading: 5. Conduct
sections.body: Treat other users with respect. Don't post false information, harass others, or attempt to take payments off-platform to avoid protections. We may suspend accounts that break these rules.

sections.heading: 6. Liability
sections.body: Crafty Bass provides the platform but does not perform the work and does not guarantee outcomes. To the extent permitted by law, our liability is limited to the fees we have charged you.

sections.heading: 7. Changes to these terms
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time. We'll show the date of the latest version above and, for significant changes, let you know in the app.

footer.tagline: Sri Lanka's marketplace connecting homeowners with trusted, verified tradespeople.

about.title: About Crafty Bass
about.intro: Crafty Bass is a Sri Lankan marketplace that connects homeowners with verified, skilled tradespeople — from plumbers and electricians to painters and masons.

sections.heading: Our mission
sections.body: Finding a reliable tradesperson shouldn't rely on luck or word of mouth. We verify every tradesperson's identity and credentials so homeowners can hire with confidence, and we give skilled professionals a fair place to grow their business.

sections.heading: How it works
sections.body: Homeowners post a job describing what they need. Verified tradespeople nearby send quotes. You compare profiles, ratings and prices, then hire the right person — with payments protected by escrow for added peace of mind.

sections.heading: Built for Sri Lanka
sections.body: Crafty Bass works in Sinhala, Tamil and English, covers all 25 districts, and is designed around how trades work locally — so both sides can communicate clearly and get the job done.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.intro: Have a question, some feedback, or need a hand with your account? We'd love to hear from you.
contact.support: Monday to Friday, 9am–6pm (Sri Lanka Standard Time). We aim to reply within one business day.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: This policy explains what personal information Crafty Bass collects, how we use it, and the choices you have. We only collect what we need to run the marketplace safely.

sections.heading: 1. Information we collect
sections.body: Account details (name, phone number, email), profile information you add, and — for tradespeople seeking verification — identity and credential documents. We also record activity such as jobs, quotes and messages so the service works.

sections.heading: 2. How we use it
sections.body: To operate the marketplace: matching jobs to tradespeople, verifying tradespeople, processing escrow payments, sending service notifications, and keeping the platform safe. We do not sell your personal information.

sections.heading: 3. Sharing
sections.body: We share only what's needed to complete a job — for example, your area and job details with quoting tradespeople. Verification documents and bank details are never shown to other users. We use trusted providers (e.g. payments, SMS) bound by contract.

sections.heading: 4. Your choices and rights
sections.body: You can view and update your profile, manage contact preferences, and request a copy or deletion of your data from your account settings. Contact us if you need help exercising these rights.

guarantee.title: The Crafty Bass Guarantee
guarantee.intro: When you hire and pay through Crafty Bass, your project is protected from the first quote to the final sign-off. Here is exactly what that covers.

pillars.heading: Verified professionals only
pillars.body: Every tradesperson who can quote on your job has had their identity and trade credentials checked. You only deal with people we have vetted.

pillars.heading: Your money is held safely
pillars.body: Payments are held in secure escrow and released to the tradesperson only when you confirm the work is done to your satisfaction.

pillars.heading: Workmanship guarantee
pillars.body: If covered work develops a fault within 12 months of completion, we help put it right — through the original tradesperson or a replacement.

pillars.heading: Dispute support
pillars.body: If something goes wrong, our support team steps in to mediate. Where the work is not completed, your escrow balance is refunded.

how.body: Accept a quote from a verified tradesperson on Crafty Bass.
Fund the job through Crafty Bass. We hold the money — the tradesperson is not paid until you approve.
Once you are happy, release the funds. The 12-month workmanship guarantee starts from this date.
If a covered fault appears, raise a claim from the job and our team helps resolve it.

covered: Work agreed and paid for through Crafty Bass escrow
Defective workmanship reported within 12 months of approval
Jobs where the tradesperson never started or abandoned the work (full escrow refund)
notCovered: Cash or off-platform payments made directly to a tradesperson
Normal wear and tear, or damage caused by misuse after completion
Changes you request outside the originally agreed scope
Claims raised more than 12 months after you approved the work
guarantee.limits: The guarantee covers eligible claims up to the value paid through Crafty Bass for the job, capped at LKR 500,000 per job. It applies only to jobs funded through Crafty Bass escrow and is not an insurance policy — it is our commitment to put covered problems right.
guarantee.claim: Open the job in your Crafty Bass account and use Report a problem, or contact our support team. Have your job reference and a description ready, with photos where possible.
